import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long V = 998244353;
    static final long X = 1000000007;
    static final int SZ = 1000000;
    static long n, nn, p;
    static int ans, tn[] = new int[7], c[][] = new int[7][7];
    static long s[][][] = new long[7][7][SZ + 1];

    static void init(int x, int l, int k) {
        s[k][l][++c[k][l]] = (++p) - x;
        if (l == k) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; ++i) {
            init(x * 10 + i, l + 1, k);
        }
    }

    static void bf(long x, int l) {
        if (x > n) return;
        ++p;
        ans = (int) ((ans + (p - x) / V - (p < x) + X) % X);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; ++i) {
            bf(x * 10 + i, l);
        }
    }

    static void solve(long x, int l) {
        if (l != 6) {
            ++p;
            ans = (int) ((ans + (p - x) / V - (p < x) + X) % X);
            for (int i = 0; i <= 9; ++i) {
                solve(x * 10 + i, l + 1);
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x == nn) return;
        int i, k;
        long v;
        for (k = 0, v = x; k <= 6 && v <= n; ++k, v *= 10);
        --k;
        for (i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
            v = p - 1L * x * tn[i];
            ans = (int) ((ans + 1L * (v / V - (v < 0 ? 1 : 0) + X) * tn[i]) % X);
            v = ((v % V) + V) % V;
            int index = Arrays.binarySearch(s[k][i], 1, c[k][i] + 1, v);
            if (index < 0) index = -index - 1;
            ans = (int) ((ans + tn[i] - (index - 1) + 1) % X);
        }
        for (i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
            p += tn[i];
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i) {
            tn[i] = tn[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k <= 6; ++k) {
            p = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
                c[k][i] = 0;
            }
            init(0, 0, k);
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; ++i) {
                Arrays.sort(s[k][i], 1, c[k][i] + 1);
            }
        }
        p = 0;
        ans = 0;
        if (p == 0 && n < 1e6) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= 9; ++i) {
                bf(i, 1);
            }
        } else {
            nn = n;
            while (nn >= 1e6) nn /= 10;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 9; ++i) {
                solve(i, 1);
            }
        }
        System.out.println((int) ((1L * (X - ans) * V) % X));
        sc.close();
    }
}
